run_gyp_uv: run gyp_uv.py to generate makefiles for the libuv project with default architecture settings
run_host_arch: run host_arch function to detect and return the current machine architecture as a GYP-compatible string
run_run_gyp: run the run_gyp function to invoke gyp.main with a list of GYP generator arguments
build_libuv_makefiles: build libuv makefiles by running gyp_uv.py with custom generator flags like -f ninja or -f make
review_gyp_uv: review gyp_uv.py to understand how it configures GYP arguments for host arch, target arch, and library type
